summary: ESCALATE. Two independent, precisely located and repairable failures of the sources criterion survive the D-2026-0001 rubric amendment, and two questions cannot be settled by any reviewer or author. The amendment does its intended work: none of Unit 6 six source keys has a bound excerpt, all six are declared under ## Unverifiable sources with attempts, date and owner authorisation, and that no longer blocks. What still fails is prose that outruns its declaration. topic-03.mdx:99-101 states as bare fact that completion rates for self-directed online courses are notoriously low, immediately after the Hennessy 2022 paragraph, while the unit own declaration at sources/unit-06.md:41 says the claim is outside that source recorded scope and that nothing there settles it, and no learner-facing sentence discloses it as uncorroborated. Separately, sources/unit-06.md:25-27 declares that no no-external-source row was needed for this unit while two unsourced empirical generalisations stand, one of them keyed by MCQ 5, so the declaration understates what it leaves unchecked. Both are named failures in the amended rubric. A third blocking defect is a three-way disagreement about how many principles a professional learning community satisfies: fig-U6-5 cell and caption say four, topic-03.mdx:113-116 says five, and the MCQ 7 answer key rationale says five, with the figure omitting the one principle topic-03 argues for; the keyed option is unaffected but the taught content contradicts itself and the figure is the designated summary. The escalation proper rests on two items no repair closes. The approved content-spec states two incompatible activity designs for Unit 6 topic 6.4 in the same subsection, with no amendment, and topic-04 silently follows one and argues against the other, which g3.md directs a reviewer to escalate rather than revise. And day1999 grounds three coverage rows while topic-02 cites Day once and only for preservice, which the declaration now discloses honestly but which no further authoring can close while the book is unobtainable. This is also the third G3 attempt, so the two-cycle repair allowance is consumed while ten of run-002 carried findings remain untouched. Everything the parent reported repaired was verified independently and found genuinely repaired: all sixteen committed SVGs measure zero text overflow, fig-U6-2 six connectors terminate at node boxes, all eight Figure carriers pass kind width and height so no lazy-load reflow remains, and the MCQ ordered list carries ten nested option lists with forty options. All ten MCQs were solved before the key was read and matched it on all ten. All six mandatory content gates exit 0 and the render inspection covers 1280px, 360px, A4 print emulation and the dark variant.

findings.message: RUN-002 FINDING 7(a) - STILL OPEN and now a definite rubric failure. topic-03.mdx:99-101 states to learners as bare fact: 'No platform sees your practice, which means it cannot supply the feedback principle, and completion rates for self-directed online courses are notoriously low without an external structure.' It sits inside the 'Online professional development platforms' section, immediately after the Hennessy and colleagues (2022) paragraph at topic-03.mdx:89-94, so a reader attributes it to that review. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-06.md:41 says the opposite in the unit's own declaration: the claim is 'outside this source's recorded scope' and 'nothing here settles it'. Under the amended g3.md 'Unavailable source text' paragraph the unretrievability of hennessy2022 is now acceptable; what is not acceptable is prose that relies on a declared-unretrievable source for a claim it does not disclose as uncorroborated, or that states more than the declaration supports. This sentence does both. No sentence in topic-03 marks it as uncorroborated, and no 'Further reading' entry supports it. REPAIR: either remove the clause, or state it as uncorroborated in the learner text in the same way topic-01.mdx:97-99 does for kwakman2003, or bind a source that covers online-course completion rates. Locator: docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/topic-03.mdx:99-101; specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-06.md:39,41.

NEW N10 - the source declaration understates what it leaves unchecked, which g3.md names as a retained failure. specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-06.md:25-27 asserts 'No `no-external-source` row was needed for this unit, unlike Unit 5: the guide's Unit 6 content is the international professional-development literature, which is well served by the sources already on the course list.' Two load-bearing empirical claims in the unit have no source at all and no such row. (a) topic-01.mdx:101-105 asserts a Pakistan-specific generalisation - 'Much available in-service provision is of the kind Mr Naeem attended: one-day, generic, delivered to a hall' and 'the structural supports that make development easy elsewhere, protected time, a subject specialist to ask, a library, are frequently absent'. The cross-reference to Unit 5 is a repository reference, not a source. (b) topic-02.mdx:70-72 asserts a cross-professional empirical comparison - 'a new doctor is supervised for years; a new teacher frequently has the same load as a colleague of twenty years standing from the first week'. This one is not decorative: MCQ 5 (unit-assessment.mdx:84-88) keys option c on exactly this proposition and the key at unit-assessment.mdx:190 confirms it, so an unsourced generalisation is load-bearing in the summative bank. A declaration that says no unsourced-claim row was needed, while two such claims stand and one is keyed, is not complete. REPAIR: add a no-external-source row covering both claims, or source them, or soften them to what the unit can support. Locators: specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-06.md:25-27; docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/topic-01.mdx:101-105; topic-02.mdx:70-72; unit-assessment.mdx:84-88,190.

RUN-002 FINDING N5 - STILL OPEN, unchanged, and now demonstrably load-bearing in the answer key. Three parts of the unit disagree on how many of the six principles a professional learning community satisfies. (1) fig-U6-5's 'Principles from 6.1 it naturally satisfies' cell for the professional learning community row reads 'Sustained, embedded, collaborative, feedback' - four - and its caption reads 'The highlighted row satisfies four of the six principles by its structure alone'. Verified by full-scale render, specs/content/efmp-302/reviews/unit-06/run003-renders/fig-U6-5-fullscale.png, and in the committed source static/img/figures/efmp-302/unit-06/fig-U6-5.svg. (2) topic-03.mdx:113-116 names five: 'sustained by construction, embedded in the school, focused on the pupils actually present, collaborative by definition, and capable of supplying feedback on real practice.' (3) The MCQ answer key at unit-assessment.mdx:192 justifies MCQ 7 with five: 'sustained, embedded, focused, collaborative and capable of supplying feedback.' topic-03.mdx:39 tells the learner 'The figure above is the summary', so the figure is the designated reference for exactly this comparison. The correct option for MCQ 7 is unaffected - the community row is the largest count on either reading - so this is not a mis-key, but a learner who counts from the figure and a marker who reads the key are working from different numbers, and the figure omits 'focused' which topic-03 argues for explicitly. REPAIR: decide whether 'focused' belongs and make the SVG cell, the SVG caption, topic-03 prose and the MCQ 7 rationale agree. Locators: static/img/figures/efmp-302/unit-06/fig-U6-5.svg (and fig-U6-5.dark.svg); docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/topic-03.mdx:39,113-116; unit-assessment.mdx:192.

RUN-002 FINDING 9 - STILL OPEN, unchanged, and escalated as contradictory G1 authority rather than restated as a content defect. specs/content/efmp-302/content-spec.md '## Unit 6' states two incompatible activity designs for the same sub-topics and records no amendment reconciling them. Its '- **Worked-example / activity concepts**' field asks for 'a short, one-term personal professional development plan naming one activity from each ways to continue developing category'. Its '**Worked-examples plan**' field, in the same subsection, asks for 'a one-page plan built in twenty minutes and reviewed in March (U6-12, U6-13)'. topic-04.mdx implements the second and argues directly against the logic of the first: topic-04.mdx:131-143 '## Activity: Build the page' is a one-page, one-goal, school-year plan, and topic-04.mdx:77-79 states 'writing one goal means explicitly not addressing five things you know are weak. That discomfort is the plan working.' The unit is therefore internally coherent and pedagogically defensible, and the one-goal design is the better one on the unit's own argument; but it silently departs from an approved G1 field, and g3.md directs a reviewer to escalate contradictory G0/G1 authority rather than revise scope. This reviewer cannot settle which field governs. OWNER DECISION NEEDED: amend the 'Worked-example / activity concepts' field to match the one-goal design, or require topic-04 to change. Locators: specs/content/efmp-302/content-spec.md '## Unit 6' (both fields); docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/topic-04.mdx:77-79,131-143.

RUN-002 FINDING 8 - PARTLY SUPERSEDED, residual uncertainty retained. specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-06.md:17-19 grounds U6-04, U6-05 and U6-06 in day1999. topic-02.mdx cites Day exactly once, at :56-58 in '### The preservice stage', and only for initial preparation being a beginning rather than a loading; the new-teacher and experienced-teacher taxonomies rest on the course guide's 6.2 bullets. Under D-2026-0001 the unretrievability of day1999 no longer blocks by itself, and the declaration at sources/unit-06.md:36 is honest and complete on this point - it records the objection verbatim, names the affected IDs, gives the date and the owner authorisation. That part of run-002's finding is therefore resolved by the rubric change. What remains is not a declaration defect but an unclosable attribution: U6-05 and U6-06 carry a source key in the coverage matrix that no one has read a supporting passage from, and no further authoring can close it while the book is unobtainable. Recorded as uncertain rather than blocking, and noted as a candidate for the audit trail rather than a repair request. Locators: specs/content/efmp-302/coverage/unit-06.md:17-19; specs/content/efmp-302/sources/unit-06.md:36,46; docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/topic-02.mdx:56-58.

RUN-002 FINDING 13 - STILL OPEN, both parts unchanged. (a) unit-assessment.mdx:210-211 gives RRQ 4 '(6 marks)' as 'Preservice, new teacher, experienced (3); transitions: responsibility transfers; mechanics become automatic and attention is freed (3)'. The arithmetic is sound but three marks are spread across two named transitions with no stated split, so two markers will divide them differently. (b) unit-assessment.mdx:233-235 gives RRQ 9's 'what each prevents' list as 'vagueness, a list of virtues, dilution across many goals, an unchosen activity, a March with nothing to look at, quiet abandonment'. Five of the six are right against topic-04.mdx. The fourth is not: the activity block does not prevent 'an unchosen activity' - that restates the block rather than naming what it prevents, and it is close to the opposite of the taught point. topic-04.mdx:56-58 gives the real consequence, an activity 'Chosen from Topic 6.3 against what that route can actually deliver', so the block prevents an activity chosen by preference rather than against what the route can deliver. A marker following the scheme literally will accept a wrong answer. Locators: unit-assessment.mdx:210-211,233-235; topic-04.mdx:56-58.

RUN-002 FINDING 12 - STILL OPEN, both sentences unchanged. Governance metadata addressed to a reviewer sits inside learner prose. topic-01.mdx:97-99: 'Note that this unit cites that work only for the question it asks; its abstract was not available when this unit was written, so no finding from it is claimed here.' topic-03.mdx:90-91: 'Note that scope: this is the right literature for this sub-topic, unlike a general claim about online learning.' Both address a reviewer rather than a B.Ed trainee, and 'when this unit was written' breaks the frame of the page. The transparency is correct and, in topic-01's case, is precisely the disclosure that finding 1 says topic-03 lacks; the objection is to the register, not the honesty. A learner-facing form ('this study asks the question but we have not been able to read its findings, so nothing is claimed from it here') would do the same work. Locators: docs/semester-1/efmp-302/unit-06/topic-01.mdx:97-99; topic-03.mdx:90-91.
